rubric.2: Faithful, correct transformation that meets the task requirements.
rubric.1: Usable, but an omission, awkward expression, or incomplete correction needs editing.
rubric.0: Wrong task or language, or an important actor, fact, certainty, or instruction changes.

method: Manual review of every recorded answer against its case rubric. Within each reviewed result file, cases absent from exceptions received 2. Keys ending @0, @1, or @2 refer to that repeat only; unqualified keys apply to all repeats. Scores are a small bespoke comparison, not a general model benchmark. Formal usted, contractions, valid paraphrases, and harmless formatting differences are accepted.
